intro.title: Infestations - Infestation Boss Stats
intro.blurb: Every Infestation is led by one faction boss, backed by waves of mobs and support creatures. This page lists each boss's weapons, health, damage and resistances, the mutation pool they draw from, and the enemies that fight alongside them. All numbers are read straight from the game files and update with every patch.
intro.profiles: Each Infestation spawns one of the faction bosses below. The weapon rolled for a spawn comes from that boss's pool.
intro.mutations: Each Infestation boss spawns with one randomly selected mutation from this pool.
intro.mechanics: All Infestation bosses share the following traits.
intro.health: Health is read from the curve table assigned to each boss, at the levels bosses spawn between. Bosses on the same curve share a row.
intro.damage: Damage per hit from each boss's hardest-hitting weapon, at the bottom and top of its spawn level range.
intro.support: Each faction also spawns support-tier creatures alongside its mobs — smaller enemies that complement the main force.
intro.npcs: Each Infestation spawns waves of regular enemies (mobs) alongside the boss. The mob mix depends on which faction controls the Infestation.

specials.name: Tesla Cannon
specials.text: Carries the BigStagger keyword and has a reload delay.

specials.name: Communist T-60 Power Armor
specials.text: The only Infestation boss that wears Power Armor — a full five-piece Communist T-60 set.

bosses.name: Assaultron Intimidator
bosses.weakSpot: None — head and torso are armoured. Aim for the limbs.

specials.name: Arm-mounted weapons
specials.text: Uses hard-wired creature weapons rather than a leveled weapon list, and fires the left and right arm weapons at the same time.

specials.name: Head Laser
specials.text: Constant-effect enchantment on the head laser.

specials.name: Lightning Strike
specials.text: Camera shake and stagger enchantments on hit.

specials.name: Holiday outfits
specials.text: Festive (Santa hat and beard) and Spooky (pumpkin head) variants, picked from a leveled outfit list.

specials.name: Cremator
specials.text: Unique fire weapon with a fire hit-effect enchantment and a faster reload.

mutations.intro: Each Infestation boss spawns with one randomly selected mutation from this pool.

list.name: Active Camouflage
list.detail: Invisible by default; becomes visible while firing or attacking.

list.name: Danger Cloud
list.summary: Harms HP and AP of nearby players
list.detail: Periodically releases a poison cloud that damages health and drains Action Points of players caught inside it.

list.name: Freezing Touch
list.detail: Melee hits trigger a cryo burst — Chilled, then Frozen on repeated hits, slowing you until you are immobilised.

list.name: Swift-Footed
list.detail: Moves faster and reloads much quicker.

list.name: Reflective Skin
list.summary: Periodically reflects direct damage to its source
list.detail: Reflects part of the damage it takes back to the attacker on a timed cycle. It glows briefly before the reflect window opens.

list.name: Resilient
list.summary: Can only be killed by a melee attack
list.detail: Cannot be killed by ranged damage — the final blow has to be a melee hit.

list.name: Savage Strike
list.detail: Bonus damage, ignores part of your damage resistance and has much tighter accuracy.

mechanics.intro: All Infestation bosses share the following traits.
rows: Each boss equips one weapon from its faction pool per spawn (listed under Boss Profiles)
Grenade use is enabled for every boss
Infestation actors also carry a scripted Fortify Health effect, so in-game health can differ from the curve value shown here
